data.narrative:
World Labs, founded by Fei-Fei Li and others, is a Series A AI & Software company that has raised $1.23B+. The valuation analysis triangulates across a comp universe of 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR), including recent stage-adjacent valuations for Scale AI ($29.0B Series B), Reflection AI ($25.0B Series A), Physical Intelligence ($5.6B Series B), Black Forest Labs ($3.2B Series B), and Field AI ($2.0B Series B).

Two methods were applied to derive a valuation range. Stage-progression analysis, using the $1.2B total raised as a proxy base value, applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement, yielding $2.5B. Peer-median analysis across five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies produced a median valuation of $5.6B, with a range spanning $2.0B to $29.0B. The dispersion reflects substantial heterogeneity within frontier AI; the high end is anchored by Reflection AI at $25.0B.

Triangulating both methods produces a valuation range of $2.1B (low) to $6.4B (high), with a median of $4.0B. Key uncertainties include differentiation within the AI & Software peer set—valuations span more than one order of magnitude—and the stage-progression assumption's sensitivity to anticipated fundraising velocity and market conditions. The analysis supports a $4.0B central estimate with meaningful downside risk to $2.1B and upside to $6.4B depending on comparative execution and market receptivity at next close.
